notes.title: JELLITITO ANNIVERSARY! CASE ANNOUNCEMENT, WORKSHOP CONTEST, NEW LOCALIZATIONS!
notes.content: [h1]Hello everyone! ✋[/h1][p][/p][p]Today marks exactly one year since the release of our beloved JELLITITO! 🥳[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/629a69684a64d3ba7bcaf1076059a008ccbf5701.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In connection with this, we have released another update that brought localizations with it. We also decided to announce a workshop contest in anticipation of releasing a case in honor of the anniversary![/p][p]So, now let's go through everything in order and in detail.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. New case and contest.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]In connection with JELLITITO turning 1 year old, we are announcing the release of a new case.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/73b8d50276a9aa536bde3cdb5170b83a136c1206.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]This case will consist entirely of works from the workshop. Therefore, show your activity, as your work may get into the case after selection! The theme doesn't matter, use your imagination to create something that will appeal to both the community and developers.[/p][p]The case will contain 28 skins for jelly, in connection with which a new rarity will be introduced:[/p][list][*][p]7 Common.[/p][/*][*][p]6 Rare.[/p][/*][*][p]5 Unique.[/p][/*][*][p]4 Legendary.[/p][/*][*][p]3 Mythic.[/p][/*][*][p]2 Epic.[/p][/*][*][p]1 Exotic.[/p][/*][/list][p]Only ONE work will be accepted from each developer. The rarity level will be determined by the number of votes. Works that receive more votes will get the highest rarity. Therefore, engage your community so they vote for you![/p][p]The launch date of the case in the game will be announced when the complete list of works is formed.[/p][p]And also: the authors of works will receive royalties not only from selling skins on the marketplace, but also from trading the case itself![/p][p]If you have any questions, you can always ask them in the game community. And for ease of working in the workshop, there is a detailed [b][url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mh6mp4zxnzQ86i-F7TjOLIfV9uY5TozHNoiSINiaOgg"]manual[/url][/b].[/p][p]Go ahead, show your activity, we are waiting for your creations![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/discussions/18446744073709551615/597412823492138883/?appid=3173050"]You can read the detailed terms in the discussion thread.[/url][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Adding localizations.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Now you can play JELLITITO in your own language! For now, the following languages have been added to the game:[/p][list][*][p]English.[/p][/*][*][p]Russian.[/p][/*][*][p]Ukrainian.[/p][/*][*][p]Spanish.[/p][/*][*][p]Portuguese.[/p][/*][*][p]German[/p][/*][*][p]French.[/p][/*][/list][p]But with future updates we will add more. To change the language, go to settings and select your preferred language:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/0f397f028153a84a4cf7ddd312be3f29ff83384e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That's all for now. Stay with us and follow the news![/p][p][/p][p]JELLITITO to everyone ✌️[/p]

notes.title: BIG UPDATE: THE JELLITITO WORKSHOP IS NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]It’s been a while since our last news update - and for good reasons. But now we’re excited to bring you some fresh features, dear players![/p][p][/p][p]Let’s go through them one by one.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]1. Workshop Added to the Game![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Creators can now design their own jelly skins for the game! And in the near future (once we finalize things with Steam 😅), they’ll even be able to earn a share of the revenue from skin sales in the in-game store and on the marketplace.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/946db5943137b592783781d3265bfec97c6584ff.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve prepared a detailed [url="https://docs.google.com/document/d/1mh6mp4zxnzQ86i-F7TjOLIfV9uY5TozHNoiSINiaOgg" style="button"]guide[/url] on how to submit your work.[/p][p]There’s also a simple and convenient upload manager for skins, accessible via a dedicated button:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/477a7afcdbedea36a7e486d35e55799461fc3474.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Before a skin makes it into the game, it will first go through a community vote and then be approved by the developers. In short - the usual process many of you are already familiar with 😀.[/p][p][/p][p]Just make sure you’ve accepted:[/p][p]- «Steam Subscriber Agreement».[/p][p]- «Supplemental Workshop Terms – Revenue Sharing».[/p][p][/p][p]If you have any questions, feel free to ask them in the Jellitito Community Hub discussions![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. Merch Button Added.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Jellitito now has its own merch page on RedBubble! You can access it anytime via the new button we’ve added to the game:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/2235c585e28935f07121e2c06628e88ad2a7b06e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Prints, [url="https://t.me/addstickers/Jellitito"]stickers[/url], posters, phone cases… We’re sure you’ll find something you love 🤩.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. Save System Overhauled.[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]We’ve changed our approach to saving and added data protection. Now, the chances of losing your progress are extremely low - only in the case of something truly unexpected 😎.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now, but more exciting updates are on the way soon. No matter what, we’re continuing to work on the game![/p][p][/p][p]Yours, Jellitito ✌️[/p]

notes.title: NEW SKINS, INTERFACE AND THE FIRST DAY OF SPRING!
notes.content:

Winter is officially over! Spring is here to replace it, and we congratulate you, dear Jellitito players! 🥳

And to celebrate, we've prepared a small update for you. So, what it includes.

[b]1. We've updated some of the interface elements! [/b]

While this is just the beginning, we plan to redesign the entire interface. But at least we found our unique style, as appetizing as the sweets on your table! 😊

notes.title: UNVEIL THE MYSTERY OF OUR DEVELOPMENTS!
notes.content:
Hey, everybody!

We'd like to lift the veil of mystery on our current work. 😏

Right now we are putting all our efforts into developing a major update that will include new mechanics and features that Steam provides! The release date for this update has not been announced yet, so stay tuned! That's why updates don't come out often now, but we still have plans to also implement small tweaks whenever possible.

[b]1. So, what are we preparing for you? [/b]
- And we plan to implement PvP with RPG elements and different game modes! On the fragment below you can already see a part of gameplay from behind the scenes of internal testing:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/dea154e7470c851ef42b7b405432b0c85ca8a516.gif[/img]

[b]2. So what's going to happen with skins, and clicker? [/b]
- The main screen with the jelly clicker will also remain, as well as the ability to get a drop every 4 hours! At the same time, skins will participate in the development of your character jelly. How - we will not tell you yet, but it is a reason to save skins, and the more the better. Type, rarity and other things will also matter. 😏

But that's not all! For the period from February 3 to February 14, we are introducing a limited drop of skins:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/230dc2c50c05698e5f47abe54a1808d174a4369f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/6311e47b8be090074f7e04a9eb41771ec8f199f4.png[/img]

And on February 14, you will be able to get a unique Mythic quality skin, which will have an increased chance of dropping!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/a101d0b858c2b72637146b974f5b547a97e0b30d.png[/img]

[b]3. Added logging.[/b]
- Now we can better collect statistics on bugs and react to them faster!

That's all for now, stay tuned and all Jellitito! ✌️

notes.title: CASE OPENING IS AVAILABLE AGAIN!
notes.content:
Great news! You can now open cases for both skins and keys again! We found a little issue that was messing things up, but everything’s working perfectly now. So feel free to open them and grab some cool new skins for the jelly and table!

Also, we’ve tweaked the system for opening skin cases: you now only need 5 items instead of 10! To open a case, you just need:
[list]
[*] 1 skin of quality "Common".
[*] 1 skin of quality "Rare".
[*] 1 skin of quality "Unique".
[*] 1 skin of quality "Legendary".
[*] 1 skin of quality "Mythic".
[/list]

Thanks for sticking with us; let’s make it Jellitito!

notes.title: Opening cases temporarily disabled
notes.content: We know you're having trouble opening cases for skins, so we've temporarily disabled the ability to open cases. We are working to find out why. All other features in the game are working fine. We will be bringing this feature back soon, but in the meantime, save collected skins!

notes.title: BIG CHRISTMAS AND NEW YEAR'S EVE UPDATE!
notes.content:
Here come the long-awaited holidays, marking the end of the old year and the start of the new! Our team wishes everyone a Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/96f4e72d55447d8f2a01f35a194393c404c91049.gif[/img]

While we've been busy preparing an exciting update for you, we didn’t quite get everything done that we wanted to. But don’t worry—we’ll make it up to you soon with some awesome updates!

In the meantime, here’s what we’ve rolled out in this release:

[h3]1. We’ve introduced a new cases system![/h3]
Now, every 4 hours, not only will skins drop, but collectible sets will too! You can find them in a new tab called “CASES.” The first one we’ve added is all about the Solar System, complete with a themed collection inside!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/21837e432ae19cc58247963f54fbbb71dd2031a6.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/e13200cbd2705ad26c1962171f9ea9b78d816e0b.jpg[/img]

Clicking on the case icon will take you to the opening scene.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/5f150b2b8f4a4a373d61d6b303431d14e86d4d2d.jpg[/img]

Another cool update: you can open the case using a key from the in-game store or by using skins from your inventory! This way, you can clear out items you don’t need or that are taking up too much space.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/75697b803624d75dacb250b128aeecbe5601f392.jpg[/img]

To open a case with a key, just make sure you have one purchased. If you want to open it with skins, here’s what you need to do:
[list]
[*] Select 4 items of “Common” quality.
[*] Select 3 items of “Rare” quality.
[*] Select 2 items of “Unique” quality.
[*] Select 1 item of “Legendary” quality.
[/list] Once you open it, you’ll get one of the items from the case at random.
[b][color=red]CAUTION![/color][/b] When you open a case, the case itself, the skins, or the key you used will be removed from your inventory!

[h3]2. With the addition of the case, we’ve also added new achievements![/h3]
These unlock as you get the corresponding skins for the jelly from the collection in your inventory.

[h3]3. We’ve added a new rarity for skins - Epic![/h3]
Now, you can only get these skins from a case. The drop chances have changed a bit, making the rarer skins even more valuable. Here’s how it breaks down for both cases and free distribution:
[list]
[*] [color=#FFFFFF]Common[/color] - 72%.
[*] [color=#0000FF]Rare[/color] - 17%.
[*] [color=#FF0000]Unique[/color] - 7,9%.
[*] [color=#FF8000]Legendary[/color] - 2,5%. 
[*] [color=#800080]Mythic[/color] - 0,55%.
[*] [color=#FFFF00]Epic[/color] - 0,05%.
[/list]
[h3]4. Changes in skins.[/h3]

[b]4.1. New skins have been added to the distribution:[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/04853d5686c5cf93c7d733065aae9cdd58bee7c5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/79e93c40b8db688b92b7df2f6dacb49ee58ac1f1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/3e20f34981a06ec32c992d9adc30312b8ee5374e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/8f3e5b416a303fac59d54c189855f48a7a550906.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/783e9f7af0d2c2a6383e1fc14589b265e94e77db.png[/img]

notes.title: Great Haloween Update!
notes.content:
Hey, guys!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/a3d0a1bccc2225754d27e47d880d99c3e3f9af3d.jpg[/img]
Halloween is imminently approaching! Have you made your candy yet? Good for you! And we have a big update for you! Let's get started.

1. New skins have been added to the game, which will drop on general conditions, that is, 1 piece every 4 hours randomly depending on rarity. New jelly skins that were added in this update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/c96877df746a97b1d3c4597f13920501f757bab2.jpg[/img]
New table skins that have been added in this update:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/7170f0af911e4c2c24b5dc9a28b7b1334f72b09e.jpg[/img]
2. Due to the celebration of Halloween, you have the opportunity to get Halloween themed skins! The giveaway will also be on general conditions, but will take place from November 31, 2024 to December 20, 2024. Don't miss your chance! The following themed skins will be given away:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45175763/8628887f0a676e2913338d3043e2318adb624eb2.jpg[/img]
3. Added a new category - Mythic!

4. With the addition of the new category, the drop chance has changed:
[list]
[*] Common Skin - 72%.
[*] Rare Skin - 20%.
[*] Unique Skin - 5%.
[*] Legendary Skin - 2.2%.
[*] Mythic Skin - 0.8%
[/list]
5. Added new sounds for jellies when clicked.

6. Added achievements! You can now get a merit badge.

7. Fixed some bugs and errors. In particular:
[list]
[*] The game has been optimized. Now the load on the CPU and video card is many times less than even 2D clickers!
[*] The inventory system has been optimized. Added auto-refresh inventory once a minute.
[*] The click when starting the game has been corrected.
[*] Modules for future updates have been added!
[/list]
This is such a huge list! We hope it's not the last one, because we still have a lot of ideas ahead of us, how to make a seemingly simple clicker fascinating and beautiful. Thank you, and booooooooooo to everyone!
